Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. items.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
items.title_cn: 假装你坐在伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯（ Elizabeth Holmes ）的办公桌前，在这个奇怪的详细网站上
items.summary: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.
items.summary_cn: Extend的工程师Bo Lau使用来自美国诉伊丽莎白·霍姆斯案审判的一千多封电子邮件、幻灯片、文本和文件，创建了一个网站，模拟了通过Theranos创始人的桌子来复枪的感觉。

items.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
items.title_cn: 被解雇的OpenAI安全研究人员对不当行为索赔提出异议，警告其产生寒蝉效应
items.summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.
items.summary_cn: 三名被解雇的OpenAI安全研究人员对有关不当处理敏感信息的指控提出异议，并在一封公开信中警告说，他们的解雇正在对该公司的人工智能安全文化产生寒蝉效应。
items.comment: 学术研究值不值，看实验设计和数据集，光看摘要都是纸上谈兵。
